toefl:pa:62.answer: I believe the most significant effect of television is its power to shape people's opinions and beliefs, often without them realizing it. Compared with the physical or educational effects that Kelly and Paul mention, this influence on people's thinking is deeper and more long-lasting.
toefl:pa:62.fullSentence: I believe the most significant effect of television is its power to shape people's opinions and beliefs, often without them realizing it. toefl:pa:63.answer: News programs, dramas, and even commercials present certain perspectives on social issues, lifestyles, and values. When viewers repeatedly see the same ideas, they may begin to accept them as normal or true. For instance, if television constantly shows an expensive lifestyle as desirable, people may begin to believe that success is mainly about earning a lot of money and buying luxury products.
toefl:pa:63.fullSentence: News programs, dramas, and even commercials present certain perspectives on social issues, lifestyles, and values. toefl:pa:64.answer: Television has this effect because it combines images, sound, and storytelling, making its messages persuasive and emotionally powerful. Also, many people watch television to relax, so they are less critical and more open to being influenced. As a result, television not only entertains or informs us but also quietly shapes how we see the world and ourselves.

Also, many people watch television to relax, so they are less critical and more open to being influenced. As a result, television not only entertains or informs us but also quietly shapes how we see the world and ourselves.
keyPhrases: quietly shapes how we see the world
toefl:pa:64.japanese: テレビがこの効果を持つのは、映像と音、物語を組み合わせることでメッセージを説得力があり感情に強く訴えるものにするからです。また、多くの人はリラックスするためにテレビを見るため、批判的でなくなり、影響を受けやすくなります。その結果、テレビは私たちを楽しませたり情報を与えたりするだけでなく、私たちが世界と自分自身をどう見るかを静かに形作ってもいます。
toefl:pa:64.explanation: 原因の説明→補足理由→結論という結論段落。

toefl:pa:65.answer: In my opinion, one of the most significant effects that watching television has on people is increasing our knowledge about many different kinds of information. Television can show news and details from various places, even from different countries, which helps us understand what is happening in the world. For example, through news reports, we can quickly learn about important events as they happen. This ability to access fast and diverse information makes television a powerful tool for keeping people informed.

toefl:pa:74.fullSentence: I need to cancel our movie plans for this Saturday because I just remembered I have a family dinner that evening. I completely forgot about it until now, and I sincerely regret any inconvenience this may cause.
keyPhrases: need to cancel our movie plans
toefl:pa:74.japanese: 今晩家族の夕食があることを思い出したため、今週土曜日の映画の予定をキャンセルしなければなりません。今の今までそれをすっかり忘れており、ご迷惑をおかけすることを心よりお詫び申し上げます。
toefl:pa:74.explanation: フォーマル版の謝罪メール。sincerely regretでより丁寧な語調。
toefl:pa:74.relatedInfo: 模範解答と見比べて、カジュアル版（映画いけない1）との文体の違いを確認しましょう。

toefl:pa:75.answer: I would still love to watch a movie together, so maybe we can reschedule for another day. Please let me know what days or times work best for you.
toefl:pa:75.fullSentence: I would still love to watch a movie together, so maybe we can reschedule for another day. Please let me know what days or times work best for you.
keyPhrases: what days or times work best for you
toefl:pa:75.japanese: それでも一緒に映画を見たいので、別の日に予定を変更できればと思います。どの日やどの時間が一番都合良いか教えてください。
toefl:pa:75.explanation: 前向きな提案と日程確認の依頼という締めの段落。
toefl:pa:75.relatedInfo: 模範解答と見比べて、would still love toの継続の気持ちの表現を確認しましょう。

toefl:pa:76.answer: I wanted to let you know that, unfortunately, I have a scheduling conflict for this Saturday evening. An important family event came up that I must attend, which means I won't be able to make it to your birthday party. I'm really sorry for missing out on the fun and celebrating with you and everyone else.
toefl:pa:76.fullSentence: I wanted to let you know that, unfortunately, I have a scheduling conflict for this Saturday evening. An important family event came up that I must attend, which means I won't be able to make it to your birthday party. I'm really sorry for missing out on the fun and celebrating with you and everyone else.
keyPhrases: won't be able to make it to your birthday party
toefl:pa:76.japanese: 残念ながら今週土曜日の夜にスケジュールが重なってしまったことをお伝えしたく思います。出席しなければならない重要な家族の行事ができてしまい、あなたの誕生日パーティーに行けなくなりました。あなたや皆さんと一緒に楽しみお祝いする機会を逃すことを本当に申し訳なく思います。
toefl:pa:76.explanation: 予定変更の報告→理由→謝罪という導入段落の型。
toefl:pa:76.relatedInfo: 模範解答と見比べて、come upの使い方を確認しましょう。

toefl:pa:77.answer: However, I'd love to catch up and celebrate with you on another day. Maybe we can meet up for coffee or dinner sometime next week? It would be great to hear all about your birthday festivities and spend some time together.
toefl:pa:77.fullSentence: However, I'd love to catch up and celebrate with you on another day. Maybe we can meet up for coffee or dinner sometime next week? It would be great to hear all about your birthday festivities and spend some time together.
keyPhrases: catch up and celebrate with you on another day
coffee or dinner sometime next week
toefl:pa:77.japanese: でも、別の日に会ってお祝いしたいです。来週のどこかでコーヒーか夕食でも一緒にどうでしょうか。誕生日のお祝いの様子を聞いたり、一緒に時間を過ごせたりしたら嬉しいです。
toefl:pa:77.explanation: 代替案の提示と前向きな気持ちを伝える段落。
toefl:pa:77.relatedInfo: 模範解答と見比べて、It would be great to〜の願望表現を確認しましょう。
